verse: yoginyo yogamārgasthāḥ kāḥ pūjyāḥ satatoditāḥ | kairdravyaiḥ pūjayed devi sṛṣṭicakraṃ mahojjvalam
ahkalasyāṃ darasthantu kuryād cakreśvara śubham | evaṃ cakrasya vinyāsaṃ kārayedakramakramam
ādau tāḥ pañcacakrasya pūjyā vandyāstu sarvataḥ | cakrasthā devadeveśyaḥ ṣoḍaśaiva mahārthagāḥ
sthitisthaṃ tu dvitīyaṃ vai sṛṣṭisthena yutaṃ kuru | tṛtīyena yathā nyāyaṃ saptamaṃ taṃ viduḥ sadā
tritīyasvaramārūḍhā sarvasaṃhārakārakī | pakṣāpakṣaṃ svayaṃ bhinnaṃ vilinā sā parā kalā
pūrvādi nāgajākrāntaṃ īśānāntamanukramam | nyamuvyāni suraśreṣṭha bhāsārūpāṇyarāsu yat
ṣoḍaśāraṃ mahādika sṛṣṭirūpaṃ sutejasam | karṇikākeśarairyuktaṃ mahātīkṣṇaṃ suśobhanam
khakārākṣaramadhyasthā daśasaptākṣarā tu sā | eṣā vidyā mahāguhyā sthiticakrasya madhyagā
jñānopāsye mahājñāne jñeyarūpe namo'stu te | kriyārūpe mahārūpe viśvarūpe namo'stu te
etad anugrahaṃ devi kuru vīrendranāyaki | yena jñātena vai samyak mūrtijñā vyomabhāvagāḥ
bhūyād bhāsakalāntare kakuhare koṭyakālollāsinī kālākālavaghaṭṭanodbhaṭatadiḥ koṭiprabhā ṭiṭṭi bhā varṇādhvāntanamantarāntara tayā līnā kṛṣāntekṣayā nityaṃ bhedakalātmakasya sahasācchedāyamātmākarī
śiroruhaiśca taṃ sthānaṃ saṃśodhyaca vicakṣaṇaḥ | lepayet tu tathā rudra ṣasanyārupiṇena ca
sthiticakrasya bhāvajña dvitīyaṃsvasvarūpakam | sṛṣṭidvādaśasaṃyuktaṃ kuru vīrendranāyakam
kalānte sarvamantrāṇāṃ mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | vyāptirūpā arūpasthā rūpātītā nirindriyā
bhavāmyadya vidhānajñe tad vadasva mamepsitam | śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇvidānīṃ parāṃ vidyāṃ siddhānāṃ bodhadarśinām
saṃyamaniyamaiścaiva  nirmuktaṃ tattvato mahat ||1/ 59 ||
tāsāṃ jñānaṃ yathā mantro  melāpaṃ tu mahāmate ||2/23 ||
na lekhyāni ca bodhātmā na vadet sarvamadhyataḥ | na pāṭhaṃ teṣu nāmeṣu kartavyaṃ vācayā hara
idaṃ cakravaraṃ vyoma trirūpaṃ triguṇodayam | trimārgaṃ tryavahaṃ nyantaṃ tristhānaṃ tu tridhāgamam
ye jñāsyanti mahāvīrā muktāste tava darśanāt | ataḥ paraṃ mahābhīmaṃ sarvasaṃhārakārakam
duṣprāpyā kālakāśāntī daśasaptākṣarāntarā | eṣā saptādaśī vidyā akṣarākṣarayā dhruvam
kakalā kārgalārūḍhā daśasaptākṣarāntarā | parekokana he kādya kālākalmaṣva kālinī
pūjayet parayā bhaktyā puṣpadhūpopahārakaiḥ | tatastu mātṛkāṃ devīṃ tridhā kuryāt tridhā tridhā
saṃpūrṇamuddhared rudra lakṣaṇe tu padaṃ tataḥ | bhavabandhani ca tathā rūpiṇīti padaṃ tataḥ
mātrāhīnā tu yā saṃvinmantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | tattvasthā tattvagahanī tattvātattvavivarjitā
bhāvābhāvavirāmānte sarvābhāve namo'stu te
sthiticakrasya yad varṇaṃ prathamaṃ śaktirūpakam | saṃhārasyāṣṭasaṃyuktaṃ ṣaṣṭametaddhi duḥsaham
kiṃ vā tubhyaṃ vahantyatāḥ (?) pṛccha tvaṃ tu paraḥ śivaḥ| kiṃ vā svabhāvabhāvena pṛcchase tu mahāmate
kathayāmi tava snehāt militaṃ ca padaṃ yathā | yoginyaḥ sarvabhāvāstu cidbhāvapadamadhyagāḥ
saṃhārakramage nityaṃ sṛṣṭirūpe namastu te | kandasthānagate nityaṃ kauṇḍalyākhye namo'stu te
kathayāmi samāsena ambarāsvararūpiṇīm | yasya vijñātamātreṇa sa sthitijño bhaved dhruvam
melāpe militā sā vai utsarge paramā citiḥ | (9) upasthasya tu madhyagā retovāhe sadoditā
taṃ namaṃ satupasarvaṃ? ṭhakāraṃ vartulaṃ mahat | kathitaṃ tava deveśa bhāsākhyaṃ tat viduḥ padam
etat svarūpaṃ vidyānāṃ yoginīnāṃ tu dhurjaṭi | pūjayed yaḥ sudhībhaktyā tasya devyo varapradāḥ
atyantagahanaṃ  gūḍhaṃ guptaṃ  guptataraṃ param ||1/ 45 ||
śuddhabuddhepadaṃ brahmā nairūpyadharmavāhana | tatastū yamārahite saṃyojya vidhināhare
pareti śabdaṃ saṃyojya vyomavāhini cātra vai | avatārarūpe kāmānte padamante niyojayet
tadājñā vartamāneha bhūtvā kramamidaṃ mahat | pūjyāḥ sarvārthadā nityāḥ śuddhā yā pādabhāvagāḥ | tāstu devyo mahādevyo mūrtayaśca prakīrtitāḥ
melāpe militā sā vai manane paramā citiḥ | (11) pītā svasya samastasya ādyā yā bodhakī daśā
puṣpadhūpopahāraiśca lepanaiśca sudīpakaiḥ | tatastu devadeveśa samayārthaprapūjaniaḥ
na tantre na ca siddhānte bhairave vātha yāmale | nāṇave srotabhede vā na śākte śāṃbhave na ca
nirāvare tataḥ paścāt viccāṇḍanyathā padam | tataśca khecaracaraiḥ śiva ca tadanantaram
manonmanaḥ kakaikavalya padaṃ yugamamataḥ param | kevalaṃ ca tadoddhṛtya nirvāṇe ca tathā cito
kathitā parameśāna pūjanavidhiruttamā | śrībhairava ūvāca tvāṃ vidyā devadeveśi sthiticakrasya bhairavi
yena jñātena pūjyeta dhyānena paramārthataḥ | khecakre cakranāthastvaṃ prā * *? paramaṃ dhruvam
